title: Yale Alumni Journey Map
subtitle: From Yale pathways to global impact, now connected in Shanghai

profiles.name: Frank Ji
yaleExperience: Interdisciplinary work bridging biology and computer science
journeyHighlights: Built cross-border community events through MuShanghai

stops.title: Where It All Began
stops.story: Growing up in Shanghai, fascinated by the intersection of biology and technology.
stops.storyCn: 在上海长大，对生物与技术的交叉领域着迷。

stops.title: The Yale Years
stops.story: PhD in computational biology, bridging biology and computer science at the frontier of both fields.
stops.storyCn: 计算生物学博士，在两个领域的前沿架起桥梁。

stops.title: Building Something New
stops.story: Co-founded MuShanghai, pivoting from academia into AI-enabled entrepreneurship and community building.
stops.storyCn: 联合创立MuShanghai，从学术转向AI驱动的创业与社区建设。

profiles.name: Marina Ross
yaleExperience: Focused on museum studies and East-West art history
Co-curated student exhibitions with visiting scholars
profiles.currentRole: Independent curator and cultural nonprofit advisor
journeyHighlights: Founded a public art education initiative

stops.title: A Childhood of Museums
stops.story: Born into a family of educators, spent weekends exploring the MFA and Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum.
stops.storyCn: 出生于教育世家，周末在波士顿美术馆和加德纳博物馆度过。

stops.title: Art History at Yale
stops.story: Immersed in museum studies and East-West art history, co-curating exhibitions with visiting scholars.
stops.storyCn: 沉浸于博物馆学与东西方艺术史，与访问学者联合策展。

stops.title: Gallery Years
stops.story: Museum research and international gallery partnerships in Manhattan, building bridges across art worlds.
stops.storyCn: 在曼哈顿从事博物馆研究与国际画廊合作，架起艺术世界的桥梁。

stops.title: Curator Without Borders
stops.story: Independent curator and cultural nonprofit advisor, founding a public art education initiative.
stops.storyCn: 独立策展人与文化非营利顾问，创办公共艺术教育项目。

profiles.name: Daniel Park
yaleExperience: Research assistant on emerging market capital flows
Student leadership in Asia-Pacific policy forum
profiles.currentRole: Managing director at a sustainable infrastructure fund
journeyHighlights: Scaled cross-border green projects in Southeast Asia

stops.title: Seoul Beginnings
stops.story: Grew up watching South Korea's economic transformation firsthand.
stops.storyCn: 亲历韩国经济转型。

stops.title: Economics at Yale
stops.story: Research on emerging market capital flows, student leadership in Asia-Pacific policy forum.
stops.storyCn: 研究新兴市场资本流动，领导亚太政策论坛。

stops.title: Investment Banking
stops.story: Analyst rising to VP at a global investment bank, learning the mechanics of capital at scale.
stops.storyCn: 从分析师晋升至全球投行副总裁，学习资本运作。

stops.title: Impact Capital
stops.story: Managing director at a sustainable infrastructure fund, scaling green projects across Southeast Asia.
stops.storyCn: 可持续基础设施基金执行董事，推动东南亚绿色项目。

profiles.name: Lucia Herrera
yaleExperience: Collaborated with public health researchers on field devices
profiles.currentRole: VP Engineering at a robotics automation company
journeyHighlights: Leads multilingual engineering teams across regions

stops.title: Engineering Roots
stops.story: Grew up in Mexico's industrial heartland, tinkering with electronics from a young age.
stops.storyCn: 在墨西哥工业重镇长大，从小就热衷摸弄电子设备。

stops.title: Yale Engineering
stops.story: MS in electrical engineering, building low-power sensing prototypes and health-tech field devices.
stops.storyCn: 电气工程硕士，构建低功耗传感原型与健康科技现场设备。

stops.title: Silicon Valley
stops.story: Semiconductor design engineer, then transitioned into industrial robotics in the Bay Area.
stops.storyCn: 半导体设计工程师，后转向湾区的工业机器人领域。

stops.title: Hardware Capital
stops.story: VP Engineering at a robotics company, leading multilingual teams building the future of automation.
stops.storyCn: 机器人公司工程副总裁，领导多语言团队构建自动化的未来。

profiles.name: Owen Cheng
yaleExperience: Longitudinal research on migration and labor
Interdisciplinary seminars with policy and data science labs
profiles.currentRole: Associate professor and public policy consultant
journeyHighlights: Advised city governments on evidence-based policy

stops.title: Pacific Coast Childhood
stops.story: Grew up in one of the world's most diverse cities, sparking a lifelong interest in urban sociology.
stops.storyCn: 在世界上最多元的城市之一长大，激发了对城市社会学的终身兴趣。

stops.title: Sociology at Yale
stops.story: PhD research on migration and labor, interdisciplinary work with policy and data science labs.
stops.storyCn: 移民与劳动研究博士，与政策和数据科学实验室跨学科合作。

stops.title: Policy & Academia
stops.story: Associate professor and public policy consultant, building civic data literacy programs.
stops.storyCn: 副教授与公共政策顾问，构建公民数据素养项目。

profiles.name: Priya Menon
yaleExperience: Clinical rotations with focus on community medicine
Capstone on digital triage and primary care access
profiles.currentRole: Physician-founder at a preventive care startup

stops.title: Tech City Origins
stops.story: Born in India's tech capital, witnessing healthcare disparities that shaped her calling.
stops.storyCn: 出生于印度科技之都，亲眼目睹的医疗差距塑造了她的使命。

stops.title: Medicine at Yale
stops.story: Clinical rotations in community medicine, capstone on digital triage and primary care access.
stops.storyCn: 社区医学临床轮转，毕业论文聚焦数字分诊与基层医疗。

stops.title: Public Health Frontlines
stops.story: Practicing in public hospital systems, witnessing scalability challenges that inspired her next move.
stops.storyCn: 在公立医院系统执业，见证可扩展性挑战并激发了下一步行动。

stops.title: Global Health Innovation
stops.story: Physician-founder of a preventive care startup, scaling data-driven chronic care programs across the Gulf.
stops.storyCn: 预防保健初创公司医生创始人，在海湾地区推广数据驱动的慢病管理。
